mentions.name: Agent-first video editing tool
mentions.description: This is a video editing tool being built from scratch that rethinks the editing workflow around AI agents rather than manual timelines, making the agent the primary interface instead of treating AI as a feature bolted on top of traditional editors.
mentions.problem: Most existing video editing tools still treat AI as a feature bolted on top rather than making the agent the primary interface.
mentions.source_excerpt: building a video editing tool from scratch — solo. The core idea is to rethink the editing workflow entirely around agents rather than manual timelines. Most existing tools still treat AI as a feature bolted on top; I'm trying to make the agent the primary interface.

evidence.value: building a video editing tool from scratch — solo. The core idea is to rethink the editing workflow entirely around agents rather than manual timelines. Most existing tools still treat AI as a feature bolted on top; I'm trying to make the agent the primary interface.
